strRegression: Structure of Regression Functions

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/strRegression.Rmd
strRegression.Rmd

Description

Internal functions for the structure of a linear regression model with random regressors in R (R Core Team, 2026): the model-implied covariance matrix, partial and standardized slopes, R-squared and adjusted R-squared, semipartial and partial correlations, Cohen’s f-squared, and the Jacobian matrices of these quantities. The functions have no input checks and are copied by other projects.

Installation

You can install the development version of strRegression from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/strRegression")

Example

The functions are internal, so they are called with :::. The model-implied covariance matrix from the parameters of a regression with two regressors.

beta <- c(0.5, 0.3)
sigmacapx <- matrix(data = c(1, 0.2, 0.2, 2), nrow = 2)
sigmacap <- strRegression:::.SigmaofTheta(
  beta = beta,
  sigmasq = 0.4,
  sigmacapx = sigmacapx
)
sigmacap
#>         [,1] [,2] [,3]
#> sigmayx 0.89 0.56  0.7
#>         0.56 1.00  0.2
#>         0.70 0.20  2.0

R-squared and the standardized slopes from the covariance matrix.

strRegression:::.RSqofSigma(sigmacap = sigmacap, k = 3)
#>   sigmayx 
#> 0.5505618
strRegression:::.BetaStarofSigma(
  sigmacap = sigmacap,
  q = 1 / sqrt(x = diag(x = sigmacap)),
  k = 3
)
#> [1] 0.5299989 0.4497190

References

R Core Team. (2026). R: A language and environment for statistical computing. R Foundation for Statistical Computing. https://www.R-project.org/
